in_sanskrit.name: Sahid
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Warrior, Brave, Hero
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Sahid एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Sahid is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'sahidh' which means 'brave' or 'hero'. This name is associated with the warrior and brahmin communities and signifies courage, strength, and determination.
